subject.title: Track Usage & Spend production hardening and sharing follow-ups

question: After the active correctness fixes land, should CodexBar sponsor native sharing and the separate scalable dashboard/share-artifact architecture as the next Usage & Spend product work?
rationale: The remaining work introduces new user-facing capability and information architecture rather than repairing the already-isolated correctness bugs.

options.title: Keep the concerns separate
options.body: Retain independent issues and require scoped proposals after the correctness PRs land, so sharing and dashboard design do not create a coupled release.

options.title: Sponsor native sharing only
options.body: Approve a narrow native macOS sharing implementation using the existing local aggregate artifact while deferring dashboard redesign.

options.title: Pause both follow-ups
options.body: Keep the current local export and dashboard contracts until a broader Usage & Spend product direction is selected.

recommendation.title: Keep the concerns separate
recommendation.body: Retain independent issues and require scoped proposals after the correctness PRs land, so sharing and dashboard design do not create a coupled release.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product scope and sequencing rather than a mechanical code repair.
